baseline: served recipe: equal-weight mean of six annually corrected members (130 reconstruction)
comparator: anchor-42 (138 columns, seed 42, no correction) = the old production recipe
small_sample_rule: a cell counts as a persistent weakness only if the sign of (mixture − anchor) repeats in ≥4 of 5 years AND its 95% day-cluster CI excludes 0; single-year cells are flagged as chance
